about.metaDescription: Who builds Clear Cart, and why.
about.heading: About us
about.intro: We built Clear Cart to take some of the daily weight out of living with an allergy. We're a small team — the product came out of our own need, and that's still how we build it.

ahmet.bio: Builds the technical side of the app; looks after the infrastructure from product recognition through to allergen matching.

asli.bio: Sets Clear Cart's direction and keeps the team focused on who the product is for, and why.

tolga.bio: Works on the product recognition models; looks after the part that gets from a photo to the right product.

vision.metaDescription: What Clear Cart is aiming for, what it does today, and the principles we build it on.
vision.heading: Vision and Mission
vision.visionBody: We imagine a weekly shop where nobody has to turn a packet over and squint at the fine print. Living with an allergy already takes enough attention; finding out what is inside a product should be the easiest part of that.
vision.missionBody: We are building a tool that recognises the product in your hand in seconds and checks its ingredients against your allergy profile. We are not trying to replace the label — we want to shorten the time you spend in the aisle and catch the allergen you might have missed.

values.title: We say when we are unsure.
values.body: If we cannot identify a product, or the ingredient data is incomplete, we tell you rather than hide it. The label on the product always has the final word.

values.title: It stays simple.
values.body: We want the app to do one thing well: take the photo, see the answer. No menus, no accounts, no extra steps in between.

values.title: Your allergy data is yours.
values.body: An allergy profile is health information. We do not use it for advertising and we do not share it with third parties.

footer.disclaimer: Clear Cart is a helper, not medical advice. If you have a serious allergy, always check the product label.
